SDK_UB_to_L1.scope: 171 reproduction container CANN 9.2 dav_c220 headers, read via the target container filesystem. No workload or service change.
SDK_UB_to_L1.interpretation: Both regular AIV UB-to-L1 and its ND-to-NZ API stage through GM, then ask the Matmul service to move the staging data into AIC L1. The API name alone cannot be credited with eliminating the probability or KV GM panel.

source_contract.first_partial: G=64, CSA, first nonfinal tile in !HEAD_RATIO_ONE. Preserve the Cube FP32 store, point it at the first partial bank, and retain the later rescaled read. Remove precisely the intervening identity read and write. Ring-slot address/layout, synchronization and retirement remain conditions.
source_contract.probabilities: Counterfactual only for a different handoff. The checked TSCM API stages via GM and removes neither logical access. An actual new handoff must eliminate the BF16 Vector-to-Cube GM write/read. The current PV already retains the left operand across its four output-column chunks. No credit for FP32 scores, partial-output handoff, shared KV, or the four existing column reuses in this component.

branches.G64_first_nonfinal: Direct first FP32 store to the partial-result bank, conditional on generation-safe reuse and compatible Fixpipe output.
branches.G64_first_final: One active tile. No first-partial identity spill and no saving.
branches.G64_later_final: Retain read of the previous FP32 partial, online-softmax rescaling, addition, division and final output.
branches.other_splits_head_ratios_draft: No extrapolation from the checked architecture and dispatch.
branches.TSCM_probabilities: Confirmed staging through GM on this SDK. No removed GM pair via this interface.

limits: Every nonempty query in an admitted compressed layer is assumed to have one 128-position SWA tile and one compressed tile of the indicated size in frozen C8. This is a conditional geometry; empty compressed rows are excluded from the first-partial credit. Flash-decode split work, alternate layouts, the two SWA-only layers and draft get no credit.

The original QK/PV arithmetic for both tiles stays. One shared arithmetic floor caps joint net traffic time before the exposure factor is applied. A lower bandwidth is a sensitivity of these traffic terms, not a new measurement. A shorter original SWA window and alignment can change probability traffic. No speed assigned to skipping vector instructions or flags.

The host source for DAV_2201 generates FLASH_DECODE=0 in this path. Data, dt/shape and task order are traced; effective selected lengths, accepted replacement tile transfer and generated machine code are not measured. The filtered FP32 copy may be redirected only with exact bank generation, alignment, fences and FP32 payload preserved.

Ordinary request results project position-dependent bounds to the local batch and use two original service references. Per-shape timing, filled rows, propagation, and branches whose verification coincides with another request may differ. Timing intervals are scenario outputs, not confidence intervals.
